auth_notes: Authentication options include Access Tokens for private/public apps and OAuth. Access tokens can be found in the developer hub.
gate_notes: API access tokens can be found and configured within the Intercom Developer Hub.
verdict_reason: Intercom provides a public REST API with clear authentication methods (OAuth and API keys) and comprehensive developer documentation, making it ready for integration.
